title: payment.outcome v1
description: billing-service -> Kafka topic `payment.outcome` -> risk engine (docs/adr/0006). What happened to a payment after the risk decision: it was captured (money moved, so it CAN charge back), or a person approved / rejected a held payment. Message value = this JSON (UTF-8), key = transaction_id. Unknown fields are ignored; a breaking change gets schema_version 2.

event_id.description: unique per event (billing's outbox id); a redelivered event is stored once

transaction_id.description: the same id billing sent to POST /v2/assess for this payment

outcome.description: captured: money taken (amount = captured amount); review_*: a person's decision on a held payment
